name: Feral pigeon
lateFeature: Twin black wing bars, silver scallops and neck iridescence
anatomyNotes: Slate head with orange eye and white cere; iridescent green-purple neck. Broad grey wing has two black bars, while tail has a dark terminal band; compact body and pink feet.
